$comment: T-181.43 negative golden, second of two. Identical to a valid document except zones[0].label carries a literal newline. The pair is deliberate and minimal: slot-callsign-separator.json pins TAB on the SLOT block and the roster wire, this one pins CR/LF on a DIFFERENT block reaching a DIFFERENT wire (TBD_BriefingService.PrettyZoneTitle -> the briefing Z record, whose rows are joined by LINE_SEP = "\n"). Because all ten sites share one $ref, a single fixture would leave nine of them free to lose the constraint unnoticed; two fixtures across two blocks and two characters is the proportionate pin. Note this fixture is also the one that proves the pattern is not merely a prose-safety rule: briefing.situation/mission/execution are POINTEDLY not constrained, because they ship as parallel array<string> RPC parameters rather than on the delimited wire, and a newline in an OPORD is legitimate authoring. See README.md for the wrapper format — this is NOT a mission document.

mustFail.because: an LF in an authored zone label opens a new ROW in the newline-joined briefing payload; the fragment after it is parsed as a record of unknown kind and the rest of the briefing is read one line out of step

meta.name: NEGATIVE FIXTURE — newline in zone label
